claim: SPY closes at or above 770.00 on the final U.S. trading session of 2026
resolution_criteria: The official NYSE Arca closing price of SPY on its final U.S. trading session of 2026 (2026-12-31) is at or above 770.00, per Yahoo Finance historical data or the fund issuer.
thesis: Spot 762.60 at the 2026-08-20 close; +1.0% over 4.3 months is below trend drift, but the bill curve pricing Fed hikes (1Y 4.00 vs EFFR 3.63) and midterm-year seasonality cap upside. Slight edge over a coin flip.

claim: NVDA moves 6 percent or more (up or down) the day after its FY2027 Q2 earnings report
resolution_criteria: Absolute value of the NVDA close-to-close percent change for the first regular Nasdaq session after its FY2027 Q2 earnings release (scheduled after market close 2026-08-26; if the date moves, the first session after the actual release governs) is greater than or equal to 6.0 percent, per official Nasdaq closing prices.
thesis: NVDA has moved 6 percent-plus on most post-2023 prints; at 5.3T market cap the print is a macro event, and the FY27 Q2 consensus EPS of 2.07 sits below the 2.39 GAAP just reported in Q1 — stale or mixed-basis estimates leave room for surprise in either direction.

claim: NVIDIA reports FY2027 Q2 revenue of 92.0 billion USD or more
resolution_criteria: Total GAAP revenue in the NVIDIA FY2027 Q2 earnings press release (quarter ending late July 2026, published at nvidia.com investor relations) is at or above 92.0 billion USD.
thesis: Fetched revenue ramp: 46.7 to 57.0 to 68.1 to 81.6B over the last four quarters, near 20 percent QoQ; 92B needs only 12.7 percent QoQ. Supply, not demand, has been the binding constraint. Kill criteria: any guided sequential decline.

claim: Equal-weight RSP underperforms SPY on total return from 2026-08-21 through 2026-11-30
resolution_criteria: Dividend-adjusted total-return percent change from the 2026-08-21 close to the 2026-11-30 close, computed from Yahoo Finance adjusted close data, is lower for RSP than for SPY.
thesis: Concentration regime intact: the AI capex narrative concentrates earnings growth in megacaps while hike-pricing rates pressure the average stock. Anchors: RSP 220.28, SPY 762.60 at the 2026-08-20 close.

claim: At least one of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, or Meta raises its full-year capex guidance by 2026-11-15
resolution_criteria: At least one of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, or Meta states a full-fiscal-year capital-expenditure guidance figure above the figure it previously guided, in an earnings release or earnings call dated 2026-08-21 through 2026-11-15 inclusive, per official releases or transcripts.
thesis: Nearly every hyperscaler print since 2024 has revised capex upward; compute scarcity persists and four independent chances inside the window make the joint probability high. Kill criteria: holds or cuts across all four in the window.

claim: The Fed raises the target range at or before its December 2026 meeting
resolution_criteria: Per the implementation notes at federalreserve.gov, the federal funds target range upper bound in effect after the December 2026 FOMC meeting is higher than the upper bound in effect on 2026-08-21.
thesis: The fetched curve prices tightening: EFFR 3.63 (Jul 2026) vs 1M bill 3.77, 1Y 4.00, 2Y 4.19 — the market leans hikes, not the cuts my stale training priors assumed (EP-000). I discount market pricing modestly: hiking into a midterm is politically brutal and the Fed tends to move slower than forwards imply.

claim: The 10-year Treasury yield prints below 4.35 percent at least once before year-end 2026
resolution_criteria: The U.S. 10-year Treasury par yield, per the Treasury.gov daily yield curve or FRED series DGS10, prints below 4.35 on at least one business day between 2026-08-21 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
thesis: 10Y at 4.65 on 2026-08-19 with a summer range near 4.38-4.75; a 30bp rally needs a growth scare or a dovish repricing — possible but not the base case while the front end prices tightening.

claim: The 30-year Treasury yield prints above 5.50 percent at least once before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: The U.S. 30-year Treasury par yield, per the Treasury.gov daily yield curve or FRED series DGS30, prints above 5.50 on at least one business day between 2026-08-21 and 2027-02-26 inclusive.
thesis: 30Y at 5.19 now and printed 5.31 on 2026-08-17; term-premium widening, heavy issuance, and hike pricing make a 5.50 touch a live tail. Base case remains chop below it.

claim: Bitcoin trades at or above 100,000 USD at some point before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: BTC-USD trades at or above 100000 USD at any time between 2026-08-21 and 2027-02-26 inclusive, per Coinbase BTC-USD trade data as aggregated by CoinGecko or TradingView.
thesis: Capitulation signature in fetched data: BTC 62,837 on 08-16 to 76,463 on 08-21, +21 percent in five days on volume tripling to 60B/day — forced-seller exhaustion. V-bottoms off liquidation lows historically retrace half the down leg; 100K needs +31 percent in six months.

claim: BlackRock BUIDL reaches 10 billion USD in AUM before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: The BlackRock BUIDL tokenized fund is reported at or above 10.0 billion USD in assets under management on any date on or before 2027-02-26, per rwa.xyz, Securitize, or a BlackRock disclosure.
thesis: Tokenized treasuries grow through crypto winters as on-chain cash seeks yield, but 10B is a multi-x step from the low-single-digit billions of early 2026, and current AUM was not fetchable at logging (EP-000 applies), so P is held modest.

claim: A U.S. spot ETF holding a crypto asset other than BTC or ETH reaches 5 billion USD AUM before 2027-01-29
resolution_criteria: At least one U.S.-listed spot exchange-traded product whose sole crypto holding is neither bitcoin nor ether reports assets under management at or above 5.0 billion USD on any date on or before 2027-01-29, per etf.com, the issuer website, or a fund press release.
thesis: The 2026 crypto drawdown crushes alt-asset inflows; 5B in a single-asset non-BTC/ETH wrapper needs both a price recovery and sustained institutional allocation. Low odds inside five months.

claim: Aggregate stablecoin market cap is at or above 400 billion USD on 2026-12-31
resolution_criteria: The DefiLlama stablecoins dashboard total stablecoin market capitalization reading on 2026-12-31 is at or above 400 billion USD.
thesis: Aggregate stablecoin cap entered 2026 near 300B; GENIUS-era issuer growth is a tailwind but the 2026 drawdown froze the leverage demand that drives minting. 33 percent growth in a bear year would surprise. Current reading not fetched at logging (EP-000).

claim: U.S. crypto market-structure legislation is signed into law by end of 2026
resolution_criteria: A U.S. federal crypto market-structure bill (the CLARITY Act or a successor bill allocating SEC and CFTC jurisdiction over digital assets) is signed into law on or before 2026-12-31, per congress.gov bill status.
thesis: Passed the House in 2025, but Senate floor time evaporates in an election year and the 2026 drawdown cooled urgency. Kill criteria for this NO-lean: a scheduled Senate floor vote.

claim: Democrats win a U.S. House majority in the November 2026 midterms
resolution_criteria: Democratic candidates win 218 or more of the 435 U.S. House seats in the 2026-11-03 midterm elections, per certified results as tallied by the Associated Press; resolves once the AP count reaches 218-plus for either party.
thesis: The out-party has gained House seats in the large majority of postwar midterms and the GOP majority is single-digit. 70 percent hedges idiosyncratic 2026 dynamics that were not fetchable at logging (EP-000: no current generic-ballot data).

claim: Apple ships the LLM-overhauled Siri as generally available in a public iOS release before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: Apple ships its redesigned LLM-based Siri as a generally available feature (not a developer or public beta) in a public iOS release on or before 2027-02-26, per Apple newsroom or official iOS release notes.
thesis: Pre-2026 reporting slated the LLM Siri for spring 2026 via an external frontier-model deal; Apple slips ship dates but rarely by a full year. Feb 2027 gives two OS point-releases of runway. Status not re-verified at logging (EP-000).

claim: NVIDIA closes a session valued at 6 trillion USD or more before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: NVDA closing market capitalization, computed as the official Nasdaq closing price times shares outstanding per the most recent 10-Q, is at or above 6.0 trillion USD on at least one trading day between 2026-08-21 and 2027-02-26 inclusive.
thesis: Fetched anchors: 216.85 close times 24.29B shares is 5.27T; the threshold needs +14 percent with two earnings prints in the window and near-20 percent QoQ revenue growth. Main risk: the hike-pricing front end compressing megacap multiples.

claim: BIS publishes a new rule further tightening AI-chip or semi-equipment exports to China before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: The Bureau of Industry and Security publishes in the Federal Register at least one new interim final or final rule that further restricts exports of advanced AI accelerators or semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China, with publication date between 2026-08-21 and 2027-02-26 inclusive.
thesis: Export-control tightening is one of the few genuinely bipartisan moves in a midterm year; BIS has published new AI-chip rules at a cadence near two per year since 2022, and the China demand for accelerators keeps the docket warm.

claim: Avengers Doomsday releases in 2026 and opens above 175 million USD domestic
resolution_criteria: Avengers Doomsday has a wide U.S. theatrical release on or before 2026-12-31 AND its three-day domestic opening weekend gross exceeds 175.0 million USD per Box Office Mojo; resolves NO if either condition fails, including a release delay past 2026-12-31.
thesis: Prior Avengers domestic openings: 207M (2012), 191M (2015), 257M (2018), 357M (2019); even with franchise fatigue, sub-175M would be the worst Avengers debut ever. Residual release-date risk is the main drag on P, and it compounds the box-office leg.

claim: TikTok is still operating for U.S. users on 2026-12-31
resolution_criteria: The TikTok app is available for download in the U.S. Apple App Store and operational for U.S. users on 2026-12-31, per the App Store listing and reporting in at least two major national news outlets.
thesis: The divestiture JV path was locked in by early 2026 and both parties own the outcome; killing the app before midterms costs young-voter goodwill nobody wants to spend. High-P entries also anchor the right tail of the calibration curve.

claim: The FDA approves an oral small-molecule GLP-1 drug before 2027-02-26
resolution_criteria: The FDA approves an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist (such as Eli Lilly orforglipron) for chronic weight management or type 2 diabetes on or before 2027-02-26, per an FDA press announcement or the Drugs@FDA database.
thesis: Orforglipron Phase 3 readouts were positive by mid-2025 with filing expected around end-2025; a standard review clock lands a decision inside the window. Oral GLP-1 is the biggest consumer-pharma catalyst of 2027. Kill criteria: a CRL or announced filing delay.
